about_the_game:
NOTE: English is NOT currently fully supported. As for now, only GUI (text of the main story not included) is supported in English. Full translation will be available soon, please stay tuned.

Story Introduction

Dreama, an otaku girl constantly torn between her love for anime, daily routines, and last-minute assignments, never imagined her life would be completely turned around by a limited-edition poster blown away by the wind. On that late autumn afternoon, she met a mysterious girl named Lyra on the cherry blossom-lined path in the park.

A first encounter over a poster and a shared "duty" in the library became the starting point of their bond. From their casual chats during library work, the heart-racing moment of an accidental fall in the storage room, the warmth of sharing a red umbrella in the rain, to the dazzling sunset glow during their confession.

Two contrasting souls gradually drew closer amidst exam papers, homework, club rumors, and the confusion of youth.

Here, there are no complicated relationships or heavy family burdens.

Just the pure and authentic daily life belonging to these girls in their youth.

Being punished for not memorizing English vocabulary, getting caught playing Gomoku during evening self-study, feeling their hearts flutter at a confession under the romantic sunset, feeling bewildered and overwhelmed by the other's radiance, and finally rushing recklessly toward the stage after acknowledging their true feelings.

When ideals collide with romance, when confusion about the future intertwines with present courage.

Can they run toward each other once more, and let the spring cherry blossoms bloom for them again?

Features

150,000-word script with multiple endings

Lighthearted, slice-of-life stories

Created by high school students, filled with authentic high school details

Character Introduction

Dreama Mung

Lyra Ye
